summary.text: Jasjit "Jay" Gotra, a businessman and former solar-sales company CEO, is running as an independent for governor in his first campaign for office. His campaign, "Grow Rhode Island Together," pairs fiscal discipline with a pledge not to seek a second term if the state is not fiscally profitable by the end of his first.

paragraphs.text: Gotra was born and raised in Mumbai, India, and immigrated to the United States as a teenager, American Bazaar reported.
He built a business career that included founding Alliance Security Inc., and he is the former CEO of Smart Green Solar, a solar sales company.
Gotra filed paperwork declaring his candidacy with the state elections board on May 8, 2026, as a Democrat.
He later qualified for the November ballot as an independent.
He has said that if Rhode Island is not fiscally profitable by the end of his first four-year term, he will not run for reelection.
